findings.alternative_explanations: Infrastructure separation is expected even between real trading partners; it neither proves nor disproves supply.
findings.contradicting_evidence: imei.us (95.216.43.145) is in the same Hetzner /16 as HalabTech's SPF IP 95.216.33.175 - a common hosting range, meaningless as evidence.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Neutral for Code-GSM / UnlocksPro LIKELY hypotheses
findings.notes: NS: code-gsm.com dns18/ns18.ovh.net; unlockspro.com rihana/chad.ns.cloudflare.com; gsmserver.com gloria/tom.ns.cloudflare.com; best4unlock.us lloyd/brianna.ns.cloudflare.com; imei.us dns1/dns2.registrar-servers.com. RDAP for these domains could not be retrieved (Parallel/Exa cannot parse application/rdap+json; rdap.org 404 for .us).

findings.entity: HalabTech subdomain inventory (CT current certs + Wayback 2015-2026)
findings.claim: About 45 HalabTech hostnames are visible (CT: chat, chatsosogsm, chatsosogsm2, chatmenet, aireply, agent, server, tools, store, admin.store, api.store; Wayback: course, digital, games, hardware, id, ip, link, pass, point, tool, techub, cert, forum, shop, demo, kontor, vb5 ...) and none is named after a supplier, API partner or white-label source.
findings.alternative_explanations: A wildcard certificate (*.halabtech.com via Cloudflare) hides proxied subdomains from CT; crt.sh history was unavailable, so older supplier-named hosts cannot be fully excluded.
findings.what_would_reject: a historical cert naming e.g. api.<supplier> or <partner>.halabtech.com
findings.notes: Wayback roots with first-capture dates: accountsystem/acsy (2017-01), support (2017-04), cert (2017-05), forum (2017-06), up/qs (2017-04), demo/dm (2018-06), kontor (2018-07), server (2019-05), en/shop (2019-11), demo1/demo2/hardware (2020), pass (2021-08), course (2021-11), ip (2022-01), digital (2022-05), tool (2022-05), link (2022-07), id (2022-08), point (2023-03), tools (2023-08), games (2023-09), latest (2024-05), supportmail (2024-08), apps/host/vb5 (2024-12), store/api.store/admin.store (2025-01), news (2025-09), techub (2025-12), chat (2025-12). CertSpotter issuers: Cloudflare (SSL.com/Google TS), Let's Encrypt (cPanel AutoSSL on tools./store.).

findings.claim: support.halabtech.com's footer credits JoudiSoft's Real Easy Store, its JS config exposes a standard userapi endpoint, and its sitemap index covers only downloads (116 file sitemaps + 7 core URLs), with no server/IMEI products.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Confirms brief (support = Real Easy Store); adds vendor JoudiSoft
findings.notes: robots.txt disallows /userapi/ and /admin/ and blocks GPTBot, Amazonbot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot etc. JSON-LD = Organization/WebSite/WebPage only. Menu links to hardware.halabtech.com and pass.halabtech.com. The /userapi/ endpoint was not called.

negative_findings.result: unavailable: 502 Bad Gateway (Exa 10:10Z, Firecrawl 10:12Z and 10:19Z), Parallel timeout 10:11Z; substituted CertSpotter (current certs only) + Wayback host list
